quarterly_data.quarter: Onto Innovation press release: Onto Innovation Completes Strategic Investment in Rigaku (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Rigaku: Onto Innovation closed its acquisition of a 27% minority equity stake in Rigaku Holdings Corporation, deepening the strategic collaboration first announced in April 2026 to advance X-ray technologies for emerging semiconductor manufacturing process-control applications. CEO Mike Plisinski cited growing process-control challenges from more complex 3D architectures and exotic materials and said 'We are excited by the initial success of our collaboration'. Onto will not consolidate Rigaku's results and will nominate a director to Rigaku's board.
